The issuer shows solid liquidity (current ratio ~2.35) and strong profitability (EBIT margin ~13% and net margin ~11%). Leverage is moderate with total liabilities at ~51% of total assets and a sizable shareholders’ equity base (~48%), supporting ongoing financial stability, but there isn’t enough evidence here to justify a higher-tier (AA/AAA) rating.  

DECISION: BBB+
